description.purpose: The moment the model's cache goes cold. It carries no schedule of its own: `./policy` keeps one one-shot schedule named `cache` under a fixed id and re-arms it per call (`rearm`), for the `cache_expires_at` the tap stamped.
description.use_when: Always, as part of the curator. It is not a poll (GH #553): every strike has a name and a time, and a model nobody calls stays silent.
description.not_in_scope: No cron, no recurring schedule. What a strike means is the `in_cache_expired` lane the hive's edge stamps on it; a strike for a call that is no longer the newest is dropped by `./policy`.
